content.text: Often used in diabetes with predominant CV risk. With established or high ASCVD risk, the plan should include a drug with proven CV-event benefit (eg, GLP-1 RA and/or SGLT2i). Advanced CKD (eGFR < 30): GLP-1 RA preferred (lower hypoglycemia risk, CV-event reduction).
